title: Mage Arena VR key art and gallery stills
label: concept key art, not a gameplay capture
note: Leonardo concept images for the competition entry. None is an in-engine screenshot or a gameplay capture; gameplay captures are still owed from Wolf. Licence status: docs/submission/ASSET-LEDGER.md.

images.prompt: First-person view from a seated player on a raised stone dais at one end of an oval Roman-era sand arena, the player's own bare hands with five fingers each in the lower foreground, stone stands and torches behind. The seated mage's two raised open palms fill the lower third, a translucent turquoise water ward arc glowing between them. Across the sand, Brennic, a broad, stocky, middle-aged fire mage: bare-headed with short dark curly hair, a full dark beard, a strong brow, a knee-length muted brick red tunic, a dark charcoal brown cloak over both shoulders, leather forearm wraps and a plain iron collar, hurls a blazing vermilion fireball straight toward the player; flames curl around his raised hands. The ward meets the fireball in a bright ring of droplets and sparks. Crowd on its feet in the stands, golden dusk sky. Cinematic wide hero composition. Stylised game concept art in the look of a simple 3D model: large readable shapes, chunky proportions, matte surfaces, one flat colour per material with no pattern and no fine texture detail, soft warm dusk light. Threat colour language: spell colour means absorb it, grey steel means dodge it, a black core with a red rim means leave. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no user interface, no VR headset, no controllers.
